name: French law: every consolidated text in DILA's LEGI base (the Constitution, the codes, laws, ordinances, decrees and orders), article by article

dates.time: 12:00 Europe/Paris (UTC+1, UTC+2 in summer time); before 1970 clamped to 1970-01-01 UTC, the real day in In-force

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactivity (statute law); criminal law: no retroactivity of harsher rules, retroactivity of milder ones
default_reach.meaning: a text provides only for the future and has no retroactive effect, unless the legislature (not a regulation) provides otherwise within constitutional limits; in criminal law a harsher rule applies only to acts committed after it takes effect, a milder one applies at once to acts not yet finally judged
default_reach.authority: Code civil, art. 2 ("La loi ne dispose que pour l'avenir ; elle n'a point d'effet rétroactif."); Déclaration des droits de l'homme et du citoyen de 1789, art. 8; Code pénal, art. 112-1

source.publisher: Direction de l'information légale et administrative (DILA)
